= Two Ids That Normalise To One Name

Keeping every component of an id means `arch/overview` and `ui/overview` stay two names.
What no normalisation can keep apart is a separator meeting the character it is replaced
by: `arch/overview` and `arch_overview` are two ids and one filename.

Contrived, and that is the point -- the residual case has to fail loudly rather than
quietly drop one of the two.

[plantuml,id="arch/overview"]
----
@startuml
Alice -> Bob : architecture
@enduml
----

[plantuml,id="arch_overview"]
----
@startuml
Carol -> Dave : also architecture
@enduml
----
